'the diff' resolves via the chunk's own header (L24 'Read the diff...'), in-chunk per rule text. 'the loop' is more of a judgment call: it is not literally named earlier in THIS file, but (a) the enclosing module's own 'What You'll Learn' signposts 'an orient -> fix -> close -> compound loop' before any exercise (getting-going.md L16), which is prior context per the module-include-order carve-out, and (b) even without that, it reads as immediate continuation of chunk 1's just-described test/fail/fix sequence (permitted, not a violation). Separately: the-wizard-move.md's own maintainer block ('no loop preview... belongs to the M1 closer') shows the curriculum treats capital-concept 'the loop' as formally earned only at the M1 closer, so if this word choice is judged premature spine vocabulary at all, rule 1's own carve-out routes that to check_writing.md §14, not slides -- flagged in notes for the writing judge, not filed here. L27 'the compound step' resolves the same way: 'Compound' is named in the module's own What You'll Learn bullet (getting-going.md L20) before this exercise is reached in deck order. Harm test: a reader holding this deck in order is not left with an unresolved noun at either point.
